chapter.verse: A kipatcilin Thu om hi; Thu pen Pasian tawh omkhawm hi; Thu pen Pasian ahi hi.
Amah pen a kipatcilin Pasian tawh omkhawm hi.
Na khempeuh ama' tungtawnin kipiangsak a, a kipiangsak lakah amah tawh lo-a kipiangsak khat zong om lo hi.
Ama' sungah nuntakna om a, tua nuntakna pen mihingte' ading khuavak ahi hi.
Tua khuavak pen khuamial sungah taang a, khuamial in tua khuavak nang zolo hi.
Pasian' sawlkhiat mi khat om a, a min John ahi hi.
Mi khempeuh tua khuavak a up theih ding deihna tawh tua khuavak thu a pulak dingin amah teci khatin hong pai hi.
Amah khuavak hilo a, tua khuavak thu teci a pang dingin hong pai hizaw hi.
Mi khempeuh khuavak a pia tua khuavak taktak pen leitung ah hong pai hi.
Amah leitung ah om a, ama' tungtawnin leitung a kipiangsak hinapi leitung in amah thei lo hi.
A mite' kianga hong pai hinapi ama' mite in amah sang lo hi.
Ahih hangin amah a sangte khempeuh—ama' min a umte khempeuh—Pasian' tate suahtheihna thu guan hi.
Tua tate pen sisan zui hilo, cilesa' deihna leh pasal' deihna tawh zong hilo-in Pasian' suahsak ahi hi.
Tu-in Thu, cilesa mihing suakin eite lakah hong teeng a, Pa' kiangpana Tapa khat bek hihna tawh a neih, hehpihna leh thumaan thutak tawh a kidim, ama' minpha i mu hi.
Ama' thu, John in teci pang a, “‘Kei' nunga hong pai mipa, kei' ma-in om khin ahih manin kei sangin lianzaw,’ ka cih pen amah ahi hi,” ci-in kiko hi.
Tua hi a, eite khempeuh in ama' cingtaakna bup panin hehpihna khat nungah khat i sang hi.
A hang pen Moses tungtawnin thukhun hong kipia a, Jesu Khris tungtawnin hehpihna leh thumaan thutak hong pai hi.
Pasian a mu ngei kuamah om lo a, Pa' ang sunga om Pasian mah ahi Tapa khat bek in Pasian hong kilangsak hi.
Jerusalem khua-a Jew mite in John' kiangah siampite leh Levi mite sawlin, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a dotsak ciangin John' teci panna hih bang ahi hi.
John in, “Kei Khris ka hikei hi,” ci-in pulak hi—im lo-in pulak hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, “Tua ahihleh kua na hi hiam? Elijah na hi hiam?” ci-in dong uh a, John in, “Hilo,” ci-in dawng hi. “Kamsangpa na hi hiam?” a cih uh ciangin, “Hilo,” mah ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in, “Kua na hi hiam? Ko hong sawlte' kiangah dawnkikna khat ka ken uh kul hi. Nangma' thu kikoici gen na hi hiam?” ci uh hi.
John in, “Kei pen kamsang Isaiah' gen mah bangin, ‘Topa' lampi tangsak un,’ a ci, gamgawtak laka kikopa' awging ka hi hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
(Amau pen Pharisee-te' sawl ahi hi).
Amaute in, “Tua ahihleh nang pen Khris lah hilo, Elijah lah hilo, Kamsangpa lah hilo, tua dingin bang hangin baptize na hi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
John in, “Ke'n tui tawh ka baptize hi. Ahi zongin na theih loh uh mi khat note lakah om hi.
Kei' nunga hong pai ahih hangin ama' khedap khau a sut ding nangawnin ka kilawm kei hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute pen John' baptizena mun, Jordan galkhat, Bethany khua-a thupiang ahi hi.
A zingciangin John in ama' kianglam Jesu hong pai a muh ciangin, “En un, leitung mite' mawhna a lakhia Pasian' Tuuno!
‘Kei' ma-in om khin ahih manin kei sangin a lianzaw mipa, kei' nungah hong pai hi,’ ka cih pen amah ahi hi.
Kei zong amah a thei ka hikei a, ahi zongin Israel mite' tungah amah a kilaak theih nadingin kei hong pai-in tui tawh a baptize ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin John in teci pang a, “Vantung pan vakhu bangin Kha hong kumsukin ama' tungah a khawl ka mu hi.
Kei zong amah a thei ka hikei a, ahi zongin tui tawh baptize dingin kei hong sawlpa in, ‘Kha hong kumsukin a khawlna mipa pen Kha Siangtho tawh a baptize-pa hi,’ hong ci hi.
Tua hi-in hih mipa Pasian' Tapa ahihlam ka mu khin a, zong teci ka pang khin hi,” ci hi.
A zingciangin ama' nungzuite nih tawh John khatvei dingkik leuleu a,
amau' gei-a lampai Jesu limtak a et kawmin, “En un, Pasian' Tuuno!” ci hi.
Ama' nungzuite gel in John' cih a zak uh ciangin Jesu zui uh hi.
Jesu kihei-in tua mite nih amah a zuih lam a muh ciangin, “Bang zong na hi uh hiam?” ci hi. Amaute in, “Rabbi aw, koi ah giak na hi hiam?” ci uh hi. (Rabbi a khiatna “Sya” cihna hi).
Jesu in, “Hong pai un, na mu ding uh hi,” ci hi. Amau zong zui uh a, ama' giahna mun va mu uh hi. Nikai nai li pawl hita ahih manin tua ni-in amaute Jesu' kiangah giak uh hi.
John' thugen za-a Jesu a zui tua mi nihte lakah khat pen Simon Peter' sanggampa Andrew ahi hi.
Andrew in a laiguizom sanggampa Simon zong masa pah a, “Messiah ka mukha uh hi,” ci hi (Messiah a khiatna Khris cihna hi).
Tua ciangin Jesu' kiangah Simon paipih hi. Jesu in Simon enin, “Nang pen John' tapa Simon na hi hi. Tu-in Cephas hong kici ding hi,” ci hi (Cephas a khiatna Peter cihna hi).
A zingciangin Jesu Galilee gam pai sawm hi. Philip mu ahih manin, “Hong zui in,” ci hi.
Philip pen Andrew leh Peter' tenna khua Bethsaida pan ahi hi.
Philip in Nathanael mu-in ama' kiangah, “Thukhun Laibu sunga Moses' gen, kamsangte in zong a gelh uh Joseph' tapa, Nazareth khuami Jesu ka mu khin uh hi,” ci hi.
Nathanael in, “Nazareth khua pan nahoih khatpeuh piang thei ding ahi hiam?” ci hi. Philip in, “Hong pai inla en in,” ci hi.
Jesu in ama' kianglam hong manawh Nathanael a muh ciangin, “En un, a sungah zuau thu a omlo Israel mi ahi taktak khat!” ci hi.
Nathanael in, “Kei hong bangci theih na hi hiam?” ci-in dong hi. Jesu in, “Philip' hong sap ma, theikung nuai-ah na om lai-in kong mu hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Nathanael in, “Rabbi, nang pen Pasian' Tapa na hi hi! Nang pen Israel Kumpi na hi hi!” ci hi.
Jesu in, “‘Theikung nuai-ah kong mu hi,’ kong cih manin hong um na hi hiam? Hihte sangin a lianzaw thute na mu lai ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah note in vantung kihongin Mihing' Tapa' tungah Pasian' vanmite a kahto a kumsuk na mu ding uh hi,” ci hi.
